rules.name: grasa-legacy-input-history-cfs
rules.sql: SELECT table_schema, table_name, table_type, table_rows, create_time, update_time FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema = 'dbsystemuat' AND (table_name LIKE '%settlement_value%' OR table_name LIKE '%settle_value%' OR table_name LIKE '%input_security%' OR table_name LIKE '%bkp%' OR table_name LIKE '%backup%' OR table_name LIKE '%hist%') ORDER BY table_name
SELECT value_date, COUNT(*) AS n FROM dbsystemuat.input_security_settlement_value_cache_table_cfs WHERE value_date BETWEEN '2026-09-28' AND '2026-10-05' GROUP BY value_date ORDER BY value_date
SELECT value_date, COUNT(*) AS n FROM dbsystemuat.input_security_settlement_value_table_cfs WHERE value_date BETWEEN '2026-09-28' AND '2026-10-05' GROUP BY value_date ORDER BY value_date
SELECT value_date, COUNT(*) AS n FROM dbsystemuat.historical_security_settlement_value_table_cfs WHERE value_date BETWEEN '2026-09-28' AND '2026-10-05' GROUP BY value_date ORDER BY value_date
